business_problem: Digi Rogaland is a regional collaboration between 20 Rogaland municipalities and Rogaland County Municipality in Western Norway. It ensures that the region's residents have access to digital solutions regardless of their municipality.
solution_summary: Digi Rogaland is a regional collaboration between 20 Rogaland municipalities and Rogaland County Municipality in Western Norway. It ensures that the region's residents have access to digital solutions regardless of their municipality. Microsoft Azure was initially chosen because it aligned seamlessly with the existing technology stack used by the municipalities, all of which are Microsoft-based. This made Microsoft Azure an easy fit. Bouvet’s consultants, with their deep understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem, leveraged their status as a specialized partner and an early adopter of Microsoft Fabric to access the latest features, offering Digi Rogaland a significant advantage. In an early pilot project, Bouvet transitioned Digi Rogaland’s solution to Microsoft Fabric, successfully exploring new features and achieving lower operational costs.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Fabric
solution_components.role: Combines real-time ingestion, storage, analytics, and activation in a unified data platform.

solution_components.name: Eventstream
solution_components.role: Captures and routes streaming events into the analytics platform for downstream analysis.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud infrastructure, security, and scaling foundation for the solution.

business_outcome: Microsoft Fabric is now Digi Rogaland’s end-to-end analytics platform.The total operating costs of the solutions are significantly lower than the previous solution and are easier to maintain.
